import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MODX = 998244353;
    static final int MODY = 1000000007;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] sumArr = new long[10];
    static long[] powArr = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static long n;
    static long countA = 0;
    static long countB = 0;
    static long answer = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean checkX(long x) {
        long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999 <= n && x * limit * 10 > n;
    }

    static void generate(int depth, long prefix) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        val[depth].add((countA - prefix + MODX) % MODX);
        sumArr[depth] += (countA - prefix + MODX) % MODX;
        countA++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generate(depth + 1, prefix * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static void process(int depth, long current) {
        if (current > n) return;
        if (checkX(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long temp = ((countB + 1 - (current * powArr[i]) % MODX) + MODX) % MODX;
                int pos = lowerBound(val[i], MODX - temp);
                long size = val[i].size();
                long sumVal = sumArr[i];
                long contribution = (sumVal + temp * size - MODX * (size - pos)) % MODY;
                answer = (answer + contribution) % MODY;
            }
            countB += countA;
        } else {
            countB++;
            long delta = ((countB - current) % MODX + MODX) % MODX;
            answer = (answer + delta) % MODY;
            for (int d = (! (depth != 0) ? 0 : 0); d <= 9; d++) {
                process(depth + 1, current * 10 + d);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        countB = -1;
        process(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
